name: Lili Labassi
description: '''Elie Moyal''', better known under his [[pseudonym|stage name]] '''Lili Labassi''' ({{langx|ar|ليلي العباسي}}; 17 September 1879 – 28 April 1969) was an [[Algerians|Algerian]] musician, [[Singer-songwriter|singer and songwriter]], mainly known for his interpretations and compositions of [[Chaabi (Algeria)|Algerian chaabi]].
